action.autotype-desc: Type username, password, and OTP in sequence
action.create-error: Could not check whether the path is free
action.create-exists: That path already has an entry — cannot create it
action.create-hint: Type a name for the new entry
action.edit-desc: Open pass edit in a terminal
action.generate-confirm-desc: Replaces the current password. This cannot be undone.
action.generate-desc: Regenerate the password with pass generate
action.new-desc: Create a new password entry here

notification.create-exists: An entry with that name already exists

autotype-enabled.desc: Show an Autotype row in an entry's detail view that types the username, a separator key, the password, then the OTP when the entry has one. Needs wtype
autotype-enabled.label: Autotype login row

autotype-separator.desc: Key that moves from the username field to the password field during autotype
autotype-separator.label: Autotype field separator

autotype-submit.desc: Press Enter after the last autotyped value (after the OTP when present, otherwise after the password). Turn off to stop before submitting
autotype-submit.label: Autotype presses Enter to submit

clip-timeout.desc: Seconds before the clipboard is cleared (blank = use PASSWORD_STORE_CLIP_TIME)
clip-timeout.label: Clipboard timeout

detail-action-grouping.desc: Interleave each value's Copy and Type rows, or list all Copy rows then all Type rows
detail-action-grouping.label: Detail view action grouping

detail-action-order.desc: Which row comes first for each value in an entry's detail view
detail-action-order.label: Detail view action order

editor-command.desc: Editor for the Edit action, exported as EDITOR to pass edit (e.g. nvim, code --wait). Blank leaves EDITOR unset so pass uses its own default
editor-command.label: Editor command

pinentry-grace-ms.desc: Milliseconds to wait for a password to decrypt before assuming a GPG pinentry prompt needs focus and hiding the launcher (default: 50). Lower values let pinentry grab focus sooner but can flicker the launcher; higher values (~200-300) are steadier but may let pinentry spawn before the timeout and miss focus depending on your window manager
pinentry-grace-ms.label: Pinentry grace period

store-path.desc: Custom path to the password store (default: ~/.password-store)
store-path.label: Password store path

terminal-command.desc: Terminal used to run pass edit, with its exec flag (e.g. foot -e, kitty -e, gnome-terminal --). Blank = auto-detect from $TERMINAL or a common terminal on PATH
terminal-command.label: Terminal command

type-delay.desc: Delay in milliseconds before typing starts (default: 500)
type-delay.label: Type delay

wtype-delay.desc: Delay between keystrokes in milliseconds for wtype (default: 12)
wtype-delay.label: wtype keystroke delay
